visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Both counters share one number
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Two counters should count on their own, but when the first is at 3 the second also starts at 4. The count variable lives outside the function that makes the counters.

solution.explanation: A variable declared inside makeCounter is created again for each call, so every counter gets its own. A variable declared outside is created once, and every counter shares it.

checks.label: The first counter is at 3 and the second at 1
